scope: Reviewer V4 implementation and direct SDK behavior
certification: Internal adversarial review; not third-party or TapeCode certification

verification.positiveControls: Every22 USDC source/destination candidate pair, localUSDT0, benign control terminology, independently agreeing semantic decisions
verification.negativeControls: Profile/asset/route drift, malformed/model-forged criterion results, independent semantic/fidelity disagreement, commitment drift, replays, changed/refetched evidence, exact permission and invoice contradictions,48 control-injection variants plus encoded invoice JSON

findings.issue: A duplicate control helper shadowed Unicode normalization during the first implementation pass.
findings.impact: Unicode-formatted override instructions could bypass the new supplemental deterministic check. This was not a deployed fund-loss finding.
findings.initialResult: Six Unicode cases failed against the first implementation; all covered cases pass after the helper correction.

findings.issue: Raw JSON-body scanning alone did not examine an invoice description after Unicode-escape decoding.
findings.impact: Equivalent JSON text could hide a control marker from the new supplemental check.
findings.fix: Check the decoded invoice description after strict invoice validation.

requiredLiveEvidence: Deploy V4 to a verified GenLayer testnet deployment and pin its source/network identity.
Verify live issuer contracts, RPC identity, token/messenger relationships and fees before enabling any candidate route.
Complete two fresh live semantic/reliability audit rounds; direct model fixtures cannot establish live validator agreement.
Verify explicit owner replacement rather than claiming old funded reviewers silently inherited this source.
remainingTrust: Semantic classification still depends on GenLayer model and validator behavior.
The instruction scan recognizes explicit control patterns; arbitrary paraphrases, encodings and languages require live adversarial evaluation.
Quoted attack instructions can require clean replacement evidence even when the surrounding product is legitimate.
GenLayer web responses lack inspectable resolved IP/final URL metadata; gateway public-network and redirect restrictions remain required.
X Layer release and CCTP delivery still rely on the documented configured attestor boundary.
